[EN] I can't move like I used to, after I saw those butterflies and the powder.
[ES] No puedo moverme como antes, después de ver esas mariposas y el polvo.

[EN] What just happened?
[ES] ¿Qué acaba de pasar?

[EN] It's nothing, Niniel...I was just remembering something about your birthday.
[ES] No es nada, Niniel... Solo recordaba algo sobre tu cumpleaños.
